title: COSA's PVP Event manager
description: CosaPvPEvent is a fully automated Minecraft Spigot/Paper plugin created by COSA for running structured PvP team events with GUIs, kits, and complete match control.
body:
![about](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6ac79e392426505792ba3a95edd3951e75d82fb_0.webp)
## CosaPvPEvent

**CosaPvPEvent** is a lightweight PvP event plugin for Minecraft servers that allows players to join team-based PvP battles with fully automated setup and management.

Players can create or join teams using an easy GUI system, fight in a custom arena, and use pre-made kits with automatic armor equipping. The plugin handles everything from countdowns to winner detection.

![line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3ae341f4272505631ca2cbf3613a68d0030e239.png)

![feature](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75b9a53e3e17f89fdeabdcac65e4da5d70169c5c_0.webp)

* 👥 GUI-based team system
* 🧰 Custom kit system with auto armor equip
* 🗺️ Arena setup system
* ▶️ Automatic event start & countdown
* 🏆 Last team standing wins
* 📊 Scoreboard & bossbar support
* 🔒 Admin-controlled setup system


## ⚙️ Commands

* `/rotipvp setlobby` – set lobby spawn
* `/rotipvp setarena` – define arena
* `/rotipvp teams` – open team GUI
* `/rotipvp kit edit <name>` – create/edit kits
* `/rotipvp start` – start event
* `/rotipvp stop` – stop event

![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21c9d76eddb10242e12ec5776ed1d7fd29b98d60.jpeg)
